newsitem.title: REPUBLIC OF IRELAND: Bank of Montreal to open Irish subsidiary.
newsitem.headline: Bank of Montreal to open Irish subsidiary.

text.p: Bank of Montreal, Canada's oldest bank, said on Wednesday that it is opening a subsidiary bank in Dublin to be called Bank of Montreal Ireland Plc.

The Irish subsidiary will play an important role in the banking group's coverage of the European market and its principal activities will include treasury services, corporate banking and the management of capital market assets.
The Dublin bank begins operations with $114 million invested capital and will ultimately employ 15 people, Bank of Montreal said in a statement.
"Ireland continues to develop its role as a centre for North American companies' European operations," Frank Techar, head of Bank of Montreal's European operations said.
"With a robust economy, a young and well-educated workforce and a favourable business climate, Ireland provides great opportunities for our clients' international activities," Techar said.
